text:
1. 特斯拉上线豆包大模型。
2. 消息人士：特朗普政府拟将加拿大进口汽车关税从25%降至15%。
3. 乘联分会：8月1-16日全国乘用车新能源市场零售39.9万辆，同比下降15%。
4. 中汽协：1—7月销量排名前十位的MPV生产企业共销售46.4万辆。
text_en:
1. Tesla launches Doubao large model.
2. Sources: Trump administration plans to cut tariffs on Canadian imported cars from 25% to 15%.
3. CPCA: Aug 1-16 national passenger vehicle NEV retail sales were 399,000 units, down 15% year-on-year.
4. CAAM: From Jan-Jul, the top 10 MPV manufacturers by sales sold 464,000 units in total.
